body: Node-only spawning (spec rule as written) cannot populate the street ahead: seed-1 sidewalk nodes are block corners only (~90 m apart along a street), so in-cone nodes within 60 m are the next intersection's corners, always in clear view. Measured street-life mean 0.00 with ring 30-120, occlusion and forward order on nodes.

Spawn candidates = nodes plus interior points every spawn_point_spacing (8 m) along each sidewalk edge (civilian_bundle already takes walker + t). Alternative rejected: node-only (0.00 in view). Deviates from GDD 6.1 wording 'на узлах графа'.
Edge-point spawns head toward the edge end nearer the player (was random). Alternative random direction measured 3.78 vs 6.59 mean in view over the 40 s steady gate.

Street-life gate measures 40 s starting when the last initial-fill civilian despawned (58.9 s in), not 20 s from t=15: the in-view count cycles 0..21 with each cross street (~20 s period at run speed) and turnover only starts once the fill crowd is 150 m behind; a 20 s window ranges 4.1..9.4. Alternative (20 s from t=15) measured 0.2-0.9 because no despawn had happened yet.
Ray budget applies to the initial fill too; the fill ends as 'exhausted' only if no in-cone candidate was skipped for budget. Alternative (unbudgeted fill) leaves rays per tick unbounded.

recycle_distance = 50 m. Measured street_ahead_stays_populated sliding-20s-min / mean: 30 m 7.94/14.98, 40 m 7.90/13.73, 50 m 7.66/13.29, 60 m 7.51/12.22, 80 m 5.04/10.73, 150 m (recycling off) 1.85/7.20 RED. 50 sits mid-plateau; alternative 30-40 m gives marginally more but recycles civilians the player just passed.

No cap on spawn candidates. Turnover bench: 6783 spawn points, deficit ticks mean 0.96 ms vs at-cap 0.82 ms (spawner scan+sort+rays ~0.15-0.2 ms). Alternative nearest-K cap rejected: nearest K clusters at the ring's inner edge in every direction and defeats the forward preference.

civilian_bench and despawn_after_2s_offscreen_beyond_150m set recycle_distance = despawn_distance: both assume a fixed crowd (bench perception bound ceil(N/slots)+1 broke at 18>17 under recycling churn because slots are assigned round-robin at spawn). Alternative (loosen the perception bound) rejected: it would weaken the existing gate; imbalance reported instead (14 agents/tick max with 40 alive under turnover).

Runtime street-life walk (release, seed 1, camera yaw pi-0.035 = headless open_street, W held) cannot measure density past ~45 m: the player stalls at a crossing near (5.6, 1.1, 5) even with max_civilians 0, so the stall is not TASK-022. Density criterion carried by the headless gate plus QA probe; runtime gives standing and the first 10 s of running only.

A per-tick recycle budget alone (recycles_per_tick 1/2/4/8, farthest first) does not reduce standing churn: spawns per 10 s standing 144/97/61, 146/91/40, 142/85/51, 150/91/57 vs 148/88/42 without a budget. The loop is spawn off-frame at the side beyond recycle_distance -> recyclable again 2 s later; the budget only spreads it out.

Recycle only calm civilians behind the view (flat offset from the player dot flat look <= 0), as GDD 6.1 already words it ('позади'), plus recycles_per_tick 1 farthest first. Standing churn 62/5/5 per 10 s (40 of the 62 are the fill). Alternative: recycle anything off-frame with a budget (churn unchanged, above). Cost: standing density after 30 s 8 vs 14 on seed 1.

Body-width occlusion = head rays at centre and +-capsule_radius (perpendicular to the flat camera ray) plus the centre feet ray, 4 per point (OCCLUSION_RAYS_PER_POINT, a law of the check), budget 16 kept = 4 points per tick. Side feet rays not added: for ground-standing buildings a blocked ray to the top of a vertical line hides the line below (same xz projection, lower height). Alternative 6 rays per point: 2 more rays for no geometric gain.

civilian_gate flake root cause: the test compared leg-left at two samples 32 updates apart; a swinging leg passes the same angle on both sides of an extreme, and the clip phase depends on how many updates asset loading took (3..11 measured). Two-sample angle measured 0.018..1.02, max-over-window 0.89..1.03. Fix: assert the largest turn from the first pose over the window. Alternative (pausing Time<Virtual> during the load wait) rejected: loading still ends at a random update, the phase stays random.

street_turnover_bench precondition lowered from >64 to >48 deficit ticks: behind-only recycling gives 65 (margin 1), recycling off gives 29. Alternative: longer RUN_S (slower test, same discrimination).

Counted half-visible corner spawns with an attribution overlay (every in-cone civilian's projected head marked with its distance on the zoom crop) instead of the round-1 raw zoom crop. Alternative (raw crop) rejected: in runtime_look spawn_05 a figure at the building corner next to a 57.8 m spawn mark was, per the overlay at the same corner and yaw in runtime_look2, a civilian at 103.9 m on the far sidewalk.
